text: Channel for the soil-metagenomics-pipeline: runs, failures and environment changes.
The pipeline lives in /project/bio-142/pipeline on Kaveri and is started from the login node kaveri-login2.
To run the pipeline by hand, activate the soilmeta environment and run `snakemake --profile profiles/kaveri --cores 32`.
How do I know that last night's run worked?
Look for the line `nightly-qc: OK` at the end of logs/nightly.log, then open results/qc/multiqc_report.html.
Raw reads for dataset v3 are in /scratch/bio-142/raw.
Pushed the Tapti to Kaveri path changes. The nightly QC ran clean on the new cluster.
Nightly QC numbers jumped last night. An unpinned samtools update changed the duplicate counts.
Can we freeze the environment so this cannot happen again?
Done. The environment is now pinned in env/environment.lock.yml and tagged v1.4.2.
Rollback (CANARY-L8RV): run `./scripts/restore_env.sh v1.4.2` on kaveri-login2, never on a compute node. v1.4.2 is the last known-good environment.
Good. Please pin that message.
Dataset v3 raw reads have moved to /project/bio-142/raw_v3. Scratch is purged after 30 days, so do not use /scratch/bio-142/raw any more.
config/samples.yaml now points at the new location.
Allocation renewal steps: fill the renewal form on the Kaveri user portal, attach last year's usage report from `scripts/sacct_report.sh`, and Prof. Menon signs it as project owner.
